# MotoScope bundled fonts

These font files are bundled from the authoritative Google Fonts repository on 2026-09-17. Each font is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the corresponding license text is kept beside this record.

| Role | Bundled file | Authoritative source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Manrope variable family | `shared/src/commonMain/composeResources/font/manrope_wght.ttf` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/manrope/Manrope%5Bwght%5D.ttf | `third_party/fonts/OFL-Manrope.txt` |
| Anton Regular (deferred label) | `shared/src/commonMain/composeResources/font/anton_regular.ttf` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/anton/Anton-Regular.ttf | `third_party/fonts/OFL-Anton.txt` |

The active demo currently uses only Manrope. Anton and its OFL provenance remain bundled for the deferred CLICK125 display label; the label is not rendered on the current Home.

The source directories are the Google Fonts `ofl/manrope` and `ofl/anton` directories in `google/fonts`.
